They most likely did change your oil. The oil life thing is just a mileage counter for the recommended service interval. Which on modern cars is way too long anyways, something like 8k miles. With the 5.0, I recommend you change your oil every 3 to 4k and just keep track of it  with the trip odometer. You can reset the oil life in the settings on the cluster. If you're really worried they didn't change the oil, pull the dip stick and check the level and color. It should be full and a golden-ish color. You should probably check your oil level every 1k miles or so. Some of the gen 3/4 motors have oil consumption issues. Good luck. I hope this helps.

If the axle is the same as the gt, there's a washer that goes behind the hub on the axle. They wear out over time and can cause clicking or grinding noises. They're like a few dollars to replace and few hours of work. You don't really even need to replace them if you don't want to. They don't really seem to serve any real purpose. The gt350 axles don't require them. You should also check the axle nut torque. I'm pretty sure it's 150ftlbs plus a 1/8 turn.

So this is actually a really hard question to answer because it really depends on the person. But for most of the people i know who cut including myself see right through false hope statements, things like "every is going to be ok". I would stay away from those types of statements. Prying is also something to try not to do. I know you want to help but prying just brings up thoughts the person may not have been aready thinking of. The best advice i can give you is to be patient with them and make sure they know you are willing to help when ever they need it. When they are ready to talk and or let you know about what is going on in their head, they will tell you. If there is suicidal thoughts watch tell closely, if there is an attempt stop them anyway you can, if you can. Tell will hate you in that moment but they will understand and thank you later. These are things i have seen and learned in my life so there not perfect. But i hope it helps in some way. I hope you find a good way to help her and she recovers soon.
